title: "Bats Exit"
subtitle: "Turn plots into bats"

revealjs-plugins:
  - plot-exit
---

## Bats: October is near

`.bats-exit` morphs each mark into a bat that flutters off and fades out. Press the forward key to try it.

::: {.fragment .bats-exit .random-order}
<!-- Each mark morphs into a bat silhouette, then flutters off and fades out. -->

```{r}
#| dev: svg

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C")
```
:::

## Bats: only some marks

`data-n="10"` works here too: only 10 randomly chosen marks turn into bats.

::: {.fragment .bats-exit .random-order data-n="10"}
<!-- Only 10 randomly chosen marks turn into bats; the rest stay put. -->

```{r}
#| dev: svg

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C")
```
:::

## Bats: histogram

Bars work too: each bar of a histogram turns into a bat.

::: {.fragment .bats-exit .random-order}
<!-- Each histogram bar morphs into a bat, then flutters off and fades out. -->

```{r}
#| dev: svg

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mpg, aes(hwy)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "#F89441", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
:::
